title: Rose at Mercado
meta_description: This fabulous *Southside 30A* 3 bedroom 3 bath penthouse condo is in the perfect location! In the heart of Rosemary Beach, overlooking the town center, and the rooftops of the community.
description_expanded: Description· Unbeatable location - steps from Rosemary Beach’s best restaurants, shops, and the Gulf of Mexico· Penthouse views - private balconies overlooking the South Side Green and Western Green· Private elevator access - your own security-coded entry for a true VIP experience· Chef’s dream kitchen - Viking appliances, SieMatic cabinets, and granite countertops· Spa-worthy master bath - jetted soaking tub and oversized walk-in stone tile shower· Access to 4 resort pools - including two gulf-side pools just steps from the beach· Covered parking included - a rare and valuable perk in Rosemary Beach· Luxury finishes throughout - crown molding, designer furnishings, and upscale details at every turn· World-class community amenities - tennis, fitness center, yoga, splash pad, playgrounds, and more· Perfect for groups - three private suites comfortably sleep 6+ guestsExperience the ultimate Rosemary Beach vacation rental at Southside 30A — a stunning 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom penthouse condo perfectly situated in one of Florida's most celebrated beach communities. Perched above the iconic town center with sweeping rooftop views, this luxury 30A condo offers walkable access to Rosemary Beach's finest restaurants, boutique shops, the Western Green, and the Gulf of Mexico's sugar-white sands and emerald waters.HOME LAYOUT (Sleeps 6)- King Primary Suite - Jetted tub, a large walk-in stone tile shower, and a double vanity & balcony access- Queen Suite - En Suite bath with bathtub- Twin Suite - Walk-In ShowerRosemary Beach Community Overview (Additional Rosemary fees for Tennis & Fitness Center)Beachside Destination with Award-Winning ArchitectureMultiple parks and common “greens” featuring playgrounds, a splash pad, a butterfly park, and secret boardwalks with tranquil fountainsFitness Center offering massage and YogaBoutique shops and restaurants on-siteSugar white sands and Emerald waters – experience one of the world’s most beautiful beaches4 Rosemary Resort PoolsBarbados Pool: gulf side, French West Indies style with vestibule fountainCoquina Pool: Gulf side, with a negative edge overflow meant for lounging and relaxingSky Pool: park side, indoor, heated year-round, with radiant heated decking in winterCabana Pool: park side, “cabana style” with adjoining children’s pool and playground parkTDT-209926
